user.title: Connect your MAX! CUL
user.description: First choose how the CUL is connected. Choose the direct option if it is plugged into the Home Assistant server. Choose network if it is connected to another device and offers a Telnet connection.

device_picker.title: Choose your CUL
device_picker.description: Choose the entry that matches your CUL. The device name, USB path, and serial number can help identify it. If you are not sure, check the label on the CUL or choose the manual option.

data_description.device_path: Choose the CUL, not another USB device. If no entry matches, select the manual option.

manual_device_path.title: Enter your CUL address
manual_device_path.description: Enter the device path shown by Home Assistant, for example /dev/serial/by-id/usb-your-device. If your CUL is on another computer, go back and choose the network option instead.

data_description.device_path: If available, use the stable path beginning with /dev/serial/by-id rather than /dev/ttyACM0.

pick_host.title: Connect over the network
pick_host.description: Enter the name or IP address of the computer or device that the CUL is connected to. This must be the address of a CUL Telnet server, not the Home Assistant address. The usual port is 2323.

data.host: CUL server name or IP address

data_description.port: Leave this as 2323 unless your CUL server uses a different port.

error.cannot_connect_to_device: Home Assistant could not open this address. Check that the CUL is powered on, the address is correct, and Home Assistant has permission to use it.
error.cul_in_use: Another program or Home Assistant add-on is using this CUL. Stop that program or add-on, then try again. A serial CUL can only be used by one program at a time.
error.cul_no_response: The CUL opened, but did not answer. Check its power and USB/network connection. If another program or add-on uses the CUL, stop it and try again.

abort.already_configured: This CUL is already set up in Home Assistant.
abort.no_paired_devices: There are no saved devices to correct yet. Pair a MAX! device first, then reopen the CulMax options.

init.title: CulMax settings
init.description: Choose one setting to change. Most people do not need to change the CUL radio address. Use the device type option only if a device appears as the wrong kind of entity.

menu_options.override_device: Fix a device shown as the wrong type

radio_settings.title: CUL radio address
radio_settings.description: This is the radio address Home Assistant uses for the CUL. Leave the suggested value unchanged unless you know it must be different.

data_description.sender_id: Advanced setting: 1193046 is the same address as 0x123456. Leave the suggested value unchanged unless you were told to use another address.

override_device.title: Choose the device to correct
override_device.description: Select the MAX! device that appears incorrectly in Home Assistant. The address and detected type help distinguish devices with similar names.

override_type.title: Choose what the device really is
override_type.description: Choose the physical device from the list. For example, choose Plug Adapter if it appeared as a thermostat. This setting affects only the selected device. To undo a correction, choose the option that says Use the type CulMax detected.

options.serial port: Plugged into the Home Assistant server

options.Enter manually: My CUL is not listed - enter its path

options.__reported__: Use the device type detected by CulMax
